source: User-supplied NCCN patient guide 2026 for education; current NCCP and medicine product information for regimen instructions

fields: Exact tumour diagnosis, site and pathology date
Grade; IDH / 1p/19q / MGMT results if tested or pending
Treatment goal; surgery / radiotherapy / chemotherapy sequence
Current regimen and phase; planned cycles or review points
What matters to me; lead team and chosen support person
Current chemotherapy dose and day-specific calendar
Steroid dose / taper / next review, if prescribed
Seizure medicines / rescue plan, if prescribed
Urgent and out-of-hours contacts; medicine-checking help
Usual symptoms and new changes: headache / seizures / strength / speech
Appetite / weight / bowels / nausea / treatment effects
Rehabilitation, practical help and carer needs
My questions and agreed next steps

groups.note: Separate medicine-safety blood tests from MRI response review and tumour-tissue biomarkers. Record the agreed plan, not a universal scan or marker timetable.
